title: Cosby Creek in Flood, Great Smoky Mountains National Park
credit_line: Photo: Stewart Tomlinson, USGS, public domain
place: Cosby Creek, Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Cocke County, Tennessee, USA
licence_evidence: USGS Multimedia Gallery page, 'Sources/Usage': "Public Domain."; 'Photographer': Stewart Tomlinson, U.S. Geological Survey. Commons copy carries {{PD-USGov-USGS}}.
notes: Cosby Creek drains to the Pigeon River, a tributary of the French Broad River (the study's French Broad River at Rosman, NC gauge is on the same river), so the scene is the same southern-Appalachian terrain as the NC mountain basins. The USGS page lists July 8, 2005; the file name and camera EXIF say 18 July 2005, so only the month is given. The bottom 32 px of the original were cropped to remove a small 'USGS' mark in the corner; otherwise only resized to 1600 px and recompressed (JPEG q72, progressive, metadata stripped).
